summary.content:
Today's selection covers 91 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Artemis Emerges From Stealth With $70 Million in Funding
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Exploited Vulnerability Exposes Nginx Servers to Hacking
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from SecurityWeek, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours
